tasks.title: Change README heading to '# Sidecar test (see notes.md)'
tasks.prompt:
Apply exactly this one find-and-replace. Do not touch any other file or line, and keep the existing line ending (CRLF) after the heading.

file: README.md
old_str: # Sidecar test
new_str: # Sidecar test (see notes.md)

(old_str occurs exactly once in README.md: it is the whole of line 1.)

Verify: run `tr -d '\r' < README.md | grep -cx '# Sidecar test (see notes.md)'` from the repository root; it must print 1.
